configurations.filens-bm25: CLI default BM25 + exact boost, cached full text, maxResults=10; source checked by SHA-256 every query.
configurations.filens-exact: CLI case-sensitive literal mode, maxResults=10; capped result list.
configurations.rg-phrase: rg -l -0 -F: case-sensitive literal query, all matching files.
configurations.rg-terms: rg -l -0 -i -F: OR of Unicode word/Han-bigram query terms, all matching files; no relevance ranking.
configurations.git-grep-terms: git grep --no-index -l -z -i -F: same OR terms, all matching files; no relevance ranking.

measurement.ordering: Five tool configurations rotated per query. Scaling alternates order across 15 repeats. Fresh process per request.
measurement.coldMeaning: Empty FiLens extraction cache, not a dropped OS page cache. One initial extraction per scale. Cached percentiles use nearest rank, n=15.
measurement.scopes: Same UTF-8 corpus for retrieval; raw document comparison uses the same FiLens extractor on both sides. Startup, enumeration, hashing/cache verification and ranking are included in CLI latency.
measurement.topKForUnranked: rg/git candidates are sorted by relative path for a reproducible capped Agent view; MRR and nDCG are not assigned. FiLens literal also ties scores and follows path order, so its MRR/nDCG are not assigned either. Candidate recall/precision includes each complete returned list. This ordering is not semantic ranking.
measurement.noAnswer: Any nonempty candidate set on absent-fact or absent-identifier queries is a false positive for this evaluation; retrieval scores do not constitute an answer detector.
measurement.tuning: Corpus and query labels frozen before runs. No query-dependent tuning; default search mode/thresholds used. Repeated documents belong to one topic family.
limits: Small synthetic developer-labelled corpus, not held-out real-world relevance or an Agent end-to-end benchmark.
Source-cache indexing and no embedding model in FiLens; this is not a full semantic-product comparison.
Numbers and phrase queries use literal relevance, including matching archives. Natural-language questions explicitly request current instructions.
Single macOS machine; no Windows/Linux performance conclusion.
Short synthetic documents dominate scaling; PDF/OCR and disk-cache behavior require larger separate studies.

scales.resourceScope: One cached CLI run via macOS time -l; maximum process RSS, not sum of simultaneous supervisor/worker memory.

documents.labelPolicy: Amount relevance includes the DOCX value written as 12,345.67: grouping punctuation is a deliberate normalization challenge. Both the invoice and scan PDF contain FILENS2026 and 12345.67.
documents.labelAudit: Source review after execution corrected two omitted scan.pdf relevance labels. Raw queries, tool outputs and timings are unchanged; both tools were rescored equally. The frozen 108-file/96-query retrieval labels were unchanged.

preliminaryAttempt.reason: Initial instrumentation aborted on an unexpected exit and did not retain stdout. Standalone replay succeeded; cause remains unconfirmed. Full rerun records failures and never retries them automatically.

notMeasured.reason: Not executed in this run; needs a separate persistent-index/embedding comparison. Its ripgrep + BM25 + vector hybrid is not represented by rg alone; no superiority claim is made.
